rows.note: Use 正史 for the officially accepted storyline or continuity of a fictional work.

example.english: In this series, this plotline isn't canon.
example.traditional: 呢套劇入面，呢段情節唔係正史。
example.jyutping: ni1 tou3 kek6 jap6 min6 ni1 dyun6 cing4 zit3 m4 hai6 zing3 si2

rows.note: Use 原則 as the all-purpose noun for a generally accepted principle or rule.

example.english: One canon I live by is that I never let money sway me.
example.traditional: 我做事有個原則，就係唔會見錢開眼。
example.jyutping: ngo5 zou6 si6 jau5 go3 jyun4 zak1 zau6 hai6 m4 wui5 gin3 cin2 hoi1 ngaan5

rows.note: Use 卡農 specifically for a musical canon or round.

example.english: This piece is a canon, with several parts entering one after another.
example.traditional: 呢首歌係卡農，幾個聲部輪住入。
example.jyutping: ni1 sau2 go1 hai6 kaa1 nung4 gei2 go3 sing1 bou6 leon4 zyu6 jap6

rows.note: Use written 正典 for an accepted body of literary works, including an author's works treated as authentic.

example.english: These works have been included in the modern literary canon.
example.traditional: 呢幾部作品已列入現代文學正典。
example.jyutping: ni1 gei2 bou6 zok3 ban2 ji5 lit6 jap6 jin6 doi6 man4 hok6 zing3 din2
